verdict.rationale: USPTO publishes its own trademark application timeline page with tables of average wait times for new applications and for each stage of examination and registration, plus an explanation of how queue position works. On the patent side it lists a 'First action estimator' tool. Missing for 10: actual current processing-time figures or update cadence shown in the evidence, documented detail on the patent first-action estimator beyond its name, per-transaction-type coverage beyond trademark stages, and independent corroboration.
